files.pricing.py:
def format_price(cents, currency="USD"):
    amount = f"{abs(cents) / 100:.2f}"
    prefix = "$" if currency == "USD" else currency + " "
    value = prefix + amount
    if cents < 0:
        value = "(" + value + ")"
    return value

import unittest
from pricing import format_price

class PricingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_existing_format(self):
        self.assertEqual(format_price(1250), "$12.50")
        self.assertEqual(format_price(-5), "($0.05)")
        self.assertEqual(format_price(500, "JPY"), "JPY 5.00")
